title: Vehicle Body 3DOF Three Axles
text: 具有纵向、横向和横摆运动的三轴车身，输入 20 路、输出 8 路；按 {Front axle tire corner stiffness, Cy_f} 指定前轮胎侧偏刚度 12e3；{Vehicle track} 指定车辆车轮数、{Axle forces} 指定车轴力类型 External longitudinal、{Front wheel steering} 指定 WhlAngF 输入端口、{Middle wheel steering} 指定 WhlAngM 输入端口、{Rear wheel steering} 指定 WhlAngR 输入端口、{External wind} 指定 WindXYZ 输入端口、{External friction} 指定 Mu 输入端口、{External forces} 指定 FExt 输入端口、{External moments} 指定 MExt 输入端口、{Hitch forces} 指定 Fh 输入端口、{Hitch moments} 指定 Mh 输入端口、{Initial longitudinal position} 指定 X_o 输入端口、{Initial yaw angle} 指定 psi_o 输入端口、{Initial longitudinal velocity} 指定 xdot_o 输入端口、{Initial yaw rate} 指定 r_o 输入端口、{Initial lateral position} 指定 Y_o 输入端口、{Air temperature} 指定 AirTemp 输入端口、{Initial lateral velocity} 指定 ydot_o 输入端口、{Number of wheels on front axle, NF} 指定前轮数量、{Number of wheels on middle axle, NM} 指定中间轮数量、{Number of wheels on rear axle, NR} 指定后轮数量、{Vehicle mass, m} 指定车辆质量、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to front axle, a} 指定从 CM 到前轴的距离、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to middle axle, b} 指定从 CM 到中间轴的距离、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to rear axle, c} 指定从 CM 到后轴的距离、{Vertical distance from center of mass to axle plane, h} 指定从 CM 到车轴平面的距离、{Vertical distance from hitch to axle plane, hh} 指定从牵引点到车轴平面的距离、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to hitch, dh} 指定从质心到牵引点的距离、{Initial inertial frame longitudinal position, X_o} 指定初始纵向位移、{Initial longitudinal velocity, xdot_o} 指定初始纵向速度、{Mapped corner stiffness} 启用映射侧偏刚度、{Include relaxation length dynamics} 启用松弛长度动态特性、{Lateral distance from geometric centerline to center of mass, d} 指定从中心线到质心的距离、{Track width, w} 指定前、中、后轮距、{Middle axle tire corner stiffness, Cy_m} 指定中间轮胎侧偏刚度 11e3、{Rear axle tire corner stiffness, Cy_r} 指定后轮胎侧偏刚度 11e3、{Front tire(s) relaxation length, sigma_f} 指定前轮胎松弛长度 .1、{Middle tire(s) relaxation length, sigma_m} 指定中间轮胎松弛长度 .1、{Rear tire(s) relaxation length, sigma_r} 指定后轮胎松弛长度 .1、{Front axle slip angle breakpoints, alpha_f_brk} 指定断点、{Front axle tire corner data, Cy_f_data} 指定前轴轮胎侧偏数据、{Middle axle slip angle breakpoints, alpha_m_brk} 指定断点、{Middle axle tire corner data, Cy_m_data} 指定中轴轮胎侧偏数据、{Rear axle slip angle breakpoints, alpha_r_brk} 指定断点、{Rear axle tire corner data, Cy_r_data} 指定后轴轮胎侧偏数据、{Initial inertial frame lateral displacement, Y_o} 指定初始横向位移、{Initial lateral velocity, ydot_o} 指定初始横向速度、{Yaw polar inertia, Izz} 指定惯性、{Initial yaw angle, psi_o} 指定 Psi 旋转、{Initial yaw rate, r_o} 指定偏航角速率、{Longitudinal drag area, Af} 指定车辆有效横截面积、{Longitudinal drag coefficient, Cd} 指定空气阻力系数 .3、{Longitudinal lift coefficient, Cl} 指定空气升力系数 .1、{Longitudinal drag pitch moment, Cpm} 指定俯仰阻力 .1、{Relative wind angle vector, beta_w} 指定风向角、{Side force coefficient vector, Cs} 指定侧向力系数、{Yaw moment coefficient vector, Cym} 指定横摆力矩阻力、{Absolute air pressure, Pabs} 指定压力、{Air temperature, Tair} 指定温度、{Gravitational acceleration, g} 指定重力、{Nominal friction scaling factor, mu} 指定摩擦比例因子、{Longitudinal velocity tolerance, xdot_tol} 指定容差 .01、{Nominal normal force, Fznom} 指定法向力、{Geometric longitudinal offset from axle plane, longOff} 指定纵向偏移、{Geometric lateral offset from center plane, latOff} 指定侧向偏移、{Geometric vertical offset from axle plane, vertOff} 指定垂直偏移、{Wrap Euler angles, wrapAng} 指定将欧拉角环绕到区间，按实例取值。
